**The Enterprise-Ready Intelligent Internal Developer Platform**

> *Bridging the Platform Engineering Chasm with AIOps Intelligence & Team Collaboration*

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Node.js Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18.0.0-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org/)

## 🎯 **The Platform Engineering Revolution**

OpenConductor solves the **Platform Engineering Chasm** with enterprise-grade team collaboration built on intelligent automation. From individual developers to enterprise teams, we deliver **80% of the value in 20% of the time** with progressive enhancement that scales with your organization.

### **🏢 Individual → Team → Enterprise Journey**
- **Start Simple**: Full-featured community platform for individual developers
- **Scale Smart**: Optional team collaboration and workspace management
- **Go Enterprise**: Advanced RBAC, analytics, and compliance features
- **Stay Flexible**: Progressive enhancement without vendor lock-in

### **🚀 15-Minute Setup → Enterprise Scale**

```bash
# Community Edition: One command, 15 minutes to working automation
npx @openconductor/install

# Enterprise Edition: Add team collaboration and advanced features
npx @openconductor/install --enterprise
# OR enable progressively: Settings → Enterprise Features → Enable

# Backstage: Months of YAML configuration, dedicated team required
# Commercial IDPs: Vendor lock-in, limited customization
```

---

## ⚡ **Quick Start - Choose Your Journey**

### **🧑‍💻 Individual Developer (Community)**
```bash
# Option 1: One-Line Installation
curl -fsSL https://install.openconductor.ai | bash

# Option 2: NPX Installation
npx @openconductor/install

# Option 3: Try the Demo
git clone https://github.com/openconductor/core.git
cd core && npm install && npm run demo:day0
# Open http://localhost:3333
```

### **👥 Team Collaboration (Enterprise)**
```bash
# Start with community, enable enterprise features later
npx @openconductor/install
# Enable in Settings → Enterprise Features → Team Management

# OR start with enterprise features enabled
npx @openconductor/install --enterprise --team-size=5
```

### **🏢 Enterprise Deployment (Enterprise+)**
```bash
# Full enterprise setup with SSO, RBAC, and compliance
npx @openconductor/install --enterprise --sso --compliance
# Includes: Advanced RBAC, audit trails, advanced analytics
```

**🎯 Target: 15 minutes to value, regardless of scale**

---

### **🔄 Progressive Enhancement Model**
- **Core Platform**: Always available - Trinity AI, MCP Registry, Workflows

- **Backward Compatible**: Existing users unaffected by enterprise features

## 🎯 **Strategic Positioning**

### **vs Backstage (Open-Source Framework)**
| Feature | Backstage | OpenConductor |
|---------|-----------|---------------|
| **Setup Time** | 3-6 months | 15 minutes |
| **Configuration** | Manual YAML | Zero-config AI |
| **Intelligence** | Static docs | Trinity AI guidance |
| **Team Collaboration** | External plugins | Built-in enterprise features |
| **Value Delivery** | Framework learning | Immediate automation |
| **TCO** | High (dedicated team) | Low (productized) |

### **vs Commercial IDPs (Port, OpsLevel, Cortex)**
| Feature | Commercial IDPs | OpenConductor |
|---------|----------------|---------------|
| **Vendor Lock-in** | High | None (open-source) |
| **AI Integration** | Basic automation | Full AIOps + Trinity AI |
| **Team Management** | Core feature | Optional enhancement |
| **Customization** | Limited | Unlimited |
| **Community** | Vendor-controlled | Open ecosystem |
| **Pricing Model** | Enterprise-only | Free → Team → Enterprise |

### **OpenConductor Subscription Tiers**
| Tier | Price | Target | Key Features |
|------|-------|--------|--------------|
| **FREE** | $0/user | Individual developers | Full Trinity AI, MCP Registry, Core workflows |
| **DEVELOPER** | $29/user/mo | Power users | Enhanced APIs, priority support |
| **TEAM** | $99/user/mo | Small teams | Team management, shared workspaces, collaboration |
| **ENTERPRISE** | Custom | Large orgs | Advanced RBAC, SSO, compliance, dedicated support |

### **Unique Value Proposition**
✅ **Progressive Enhancement**: Start free, add enterprise features when needed
✅ **AIOps + IDP + Teams**: Only platform combining operational intelligence with team collaboration
✅ **Platform Engineering Chasm**: Solved with open + enterprise benefits
✅ **15-Minute Value**: Fastest time-to-automation, any scale
✅ **Trinity AI**: Predictive, monitoring, and advisory intelligence
✅ **No Migration Pain**: Enable enterprise features without platform changes
